dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Investigate

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (This shrine seems to be in good condition, and appears to have been maintained quite carefully in recent days. The person who did this must be conscientious indeed.)

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (Otherwise, there are no traces of someone having been here.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How strange... seems like someone's been here before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's another shrine over there. Let's take a look, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Investigate

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (This shrine is clean and tidy, and gives off the faint fragrance of the Sacred Sakura. Someone has prayed here recently.)

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (Otherwise, there are no newer traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This scent is... the Sacred Sakura's! Chouji's mom might have come by this place!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pretty recently, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This shrine looks super new! Let's take a closer look at it!

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Investigate

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (The wood of this shrine is somewhat old, but skilled maintenance has made it seem less dilapidated in its age and more charming instead.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like someone often comes to take care of this shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is probably the shrine that Chouji mentioned, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Investigate

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (The shrine is simple but elegant. Its wood shimmers slightly, greeting guests and their offerings with solemn silence.)

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (Many Sacred Sakura petals lie scattered around this shrine, though it is not a natural scene. Instead, it seems more like someone intentionally scattered the Sakura Blooms here.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... There aren't any traces here, either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right. Chouji mentioned that his mom would present this offering to the shrine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are so many petals here, too... This can't be a coincidence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go back and tell him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are shrines here too, looks familiar!

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (It looks like an ordinary shrine — there is a distinct lack of any strange elemental traces.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Investigate

dialogues.speaker: Shrine
dialogues.text: (This shrine looks pretty dilapidated. The wooden facade has become pitted and faded, revealing traces of dangerous dark red lines underneath.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This shrine is super creepy... Paimon's getting goosebumps...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get out of here!
